verdict.line: You lose if you let Garen auto you down unblinded and eat repeated Judgment spins; you win if you poke with Toxic Shot from range and blind his Decisive Strike the moment he commits.

brief.thesis: Teemo's autoattacks and Toxic Shot reach 680 range while every one of Garen's tools caps at 325 or less, so this lane is a pure kiting problem for Garen. Decisive Strike's bonus damage and silence only trigger if the attack actually lands, which means Blinding Dart fully erases his one gap-close-and-punish tool.

theirWindow.when: Garen's Q is up, closing in
theirWindow.what: He'll pop Decisive Strike's speed burst to break any slow and run at you; if his hit lands, the attack silences you on top of bonus damage, so don't just walk away and let him catch the auto.

yourWindow.when: His Q and E both down
yourWindow.what: With Decisive Strike and Judgment on cooldown Garen has no way to close distance or punish your trade, so walk up, land Q (Blinding Dart) and a few E-stacked autoattacks, then step back out of his 325 range.

start.why: Highest-sample start (71.5% pick, 51.1% wr over 1762 games) and the mana sustain lets you spam Blinding Dart every time his Q comes off cooldown instead of rationing it.

boots.why: Slightly higher winrate and pick rate (51.4%, 49.6% over 1189 games) than Sorcerer's Shoes, and the flat speed stacks with Move Quick to keep you permanently out of his 325-range kit.

core.why: Most-picked first core item (37.3% pick in the top path) — the attack speed and proc let you stack Toxic Shot faster during trades.
Pairs with Toxic Shot's damage-over-time to punish Garen for standing in poke range trying to proc his own passive regen.
Caps the most popular and highest-winrate core path (53.3% over 655 games) with a cooldown-reduction spike for Blinding Dart uptime.

situational.when: you are already ahead on poke damage and want to burst him down in skirmishes
you need more attack speed to stack Toxic Shot faster against his regen
the lane is won and you want to scale into teamfight burst

runes.keystoneWhy: Your 680-range autoattacks stack Press the Attack from outside his 325-range kit, so you amplify damage on him for free before he can ever threaten a trade back.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the overwhelming standard here (90.7% pick, 51.1% wr) — Ignite's burn denies Garen's Perseverance passive from healing back any poke damage once a trade ends.

playing.title: Poke with Toxic Shot
playing.detail: Autoattack Garen whenever he's inside your 680 range; E applies poison instantly on a 0s cooldown, so every landed hit chips him down and keeps his Perseverance regen from ever ticking.

playing.title: Save Q for his Q
playing.detail: Hold Blinding Dart until Garen uses Decisive Strike's speed burst to close distance. Landing the blind makes his follow-up attack miss entirely, so the bonus damage and silence never go off — and your Q is back up in 8s for the next engage.

playing.title: Kite with Move Quick
playing.detail: Let W's passive speed build while he's not hitting you, then burn the sprint the moment he closes in — only his strikes interrupt the speedup, not his spells.

playing.title: Respect Judgment windows
playing.detail: Garen's E deals physical damage to everything near him on a 13/12/11/10/9s cooldown. Don't stand next to him for an extra auto; let the spin end before you step back in.

playing.title: Track his ultimate cooldown
playing.detail: Demacian Justice attempts to execute at 400 range on a 140s cooldown at rank 1, falling to 20s once maxed. Play aggressive while it's down; play around your health threshold once he hits level 16-18.

playing.title: End trades before he resets
playing.detail: Since Garen heals a percentage of health per second once unbothered, never walk away from a trade without one more auto or a Noxious Trap dropped on his retreat path.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, and all winrate/pickrate numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Garen is weak without his Decisive Strike (Q). If he closes in using Decisive Strike (Q), use Blinding Dart [Q] to block it.
